Study Scholarships for Graduates of All Disciplines

Objective

Scholarships for foreign graduates to complete a Master's degree in Germany, including computer science and data science.

Who can apply?

Graduates who have completed a Bachelor's degree, or will by the start of the scholarship, from the Palestinian Territories.

Application deadline

31 January 2027

Value

Monthly payment of 992 euros, health insurance, travel allowance. Fully funded.

Language skills

For English-taught programmes: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90.
